settings/localResolution.title: Local resolution
settings/localResolution.body: Resolution requested on the local network. FSR choices request a lower source resolution and upscale it for display.

settings/localFps.title: Local frame rate
settings/localFps.body: Maximum frame rate requested for local-network play. The console may send fewer frames.

settings/localBitrate.title: Local bitrate
settings/localBitrate.body: Video bitrate requested on the local network, in 500-kbps steps. The console may deliver less.

settings/remoteResolution.title: Remote resolution
settings/remoteResolution.body: Resolution requested for direct internet Remote Play. FSR choices request a lower source resolution and upscale it for display.

settings/remoteFps.title: Remote frame rate
settings/remoteFps.body: Maximum frame rate requested for direct internet Remote Play. The console may send fewer frames.

settings/remoteBitrate.title: Remote bitrate
settings/remoteBitrate.body: Video bitrate requested for direct internet Remote Play, in 500-kbps steps. The console may deliver less.

settings/vpnResolution.title: VPN resolution
settings/vpnResolution.body: Resolution requested through Akira's WireGuard tunnel. FSR choices request a lower source resolution and upscale it for display.

settings/vpnFps.title: VPN frame rate
settings/vpnFps.body: Maximum frame rate requested through Akira's WireGuard tunnel. The console may send fewer frames.

settings/vpnBitrate.title: VPN bitrate
settings/vpnBitrate.body: Video bitrate requested through Akira's WireGuard tunnel, in 500-kbps steps. The console may deliver less.

settings/pscloudResolution.title: PS5 cloud resolution
settings/pscloudResolution.body: Resolution requested from PS5 cloud streaming. The 1080p FSR choice requests 720p and upscales it for display.

settings/pscloudBitrate.title: PS5 cloud bitrate
settings/pscloudBitrate.body: Video bitrate requested from PS5 cloud streaming, in 500-kbps steps. The service may deliver less.

settings/psnowResolution.title: PS Now resolution
settings/psnowResolution.body: Resolution requested from PS Now streaming. The 1080p FSR choice requests 720p and upscales it for display.

settings/psnowBitrate.title: PS Now bitrate
settings/psnowBitrate.body: Video bitrate requested from PS Now streaming, in 500-kbps steps. The service may deliver less.

settings/enableDithering.title: Dithering
settings/enableDithering.body: Add subtle noise to reduce visible color banding in gradients.

settings/ditheringStrength.title: Dither strength
settings/ditheringStrength.body: Set the amount of dithering noise from level 1 to 10.

settings/rcasEnabled.title: RCAS sharpening
settings/rcasEnabled.body: Apply contrast-adaptive sharpening to the decoded image.

settings/rcasSharpness.title: RCAS strength
settings/rcasSharpness.body: Set sharpening in 5-percentage-point steps. High values can emphasize compression artifacts.
